newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian real ends soft on dollar short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian real ends soft on dollar short-covering.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.06 percent to close at 1.0607 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market as banks covered short dollar positions, dealers said.
Covering short positions is normal at midweek, when it is cheaper to hold dollars for a variety of technical reasons, they added.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real rose 0.03 percent to end at 1.0659 per dollar due to a slight increase in the supply of dollars, traders said.
In the parallel market, the real fell 0.89 percent, closing at 1.135 per dollar.
